Coram : M.R. SHAH, B.V. NAGARATHNA
Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005: ss.12, 17, 19, 22 – Domestic violence – Allegations of, by the aggrieved person-wife – Death of the husband within one month of the marriage in a car accident – Birth of daughter within a year of marriage – After tortured and harassed by her mother-in-law and her matrimonial family, and was forced to leave her matrimonial home – She started working to support herself and her child – Issuance of notice to the respondents to return her stridhana but there was no response – Aggrieved person
Decision Date : 12-05-2022 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 511/2022 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
